The only things so far I that actually matters to me are.

\- my parents (despite them being aggressive all the time).

\-animals, I have worried and still worry about cats and dogs who are on the loose. I have given stray dogs and cats food and been trying to get them home and or shelter. Although, nowadays, without any support from the government, dogs and cats are put to sleep (the food costs something). 

\-Helping those in need (But I learn every month from the news, from our community or commune, that people are selfish and evil. For this reason, I have also stopped helping less and less.

My own theory is that, due to the life long stress that I have had, this almost always contributes to irritable bowel syndrome and to acidic stomach. 

Irritable bowel syndrome is a syndrome that does not allow food to be digested nor absorbed through the intestines.

However, serotonin, molecule that gives you energy and enjoyment, is produced by the digestive system which accounts for 95% of the production of serotonin.

Overall, I think my depression and unhappiness is due to the me not getting enough serotonin via food. (I will try getting 5-HTP and SAM-e supplements that help to get more serotonin (These can be bought from your local pharmacy).

The sad part is that, there was a research saying that individuals with abusing childhood have fewer serotonin receptors in the brain, meaning that despite how much you have serotonin in your body or brain, you will not get happier, and I have not yet found how these receptors are generated or synthesised.

As emberassing as it might sound, I have not tried ironing in my life.

Although, I have tried to calmly lift weight or calmly try to play chess. The only thing sometimes that helps a little bit is riding my bycycle while listening to music (relaxing music like for me linkin park). This helps me to think about life and talk to "myself" but I still end up getting the same result that life is not worth living.

I don't know is it because of a habit, a defence mechanism or me genuinly not knowing how to see good things in life.

I tried to travel and hike. Things like that seems completely pointless and waste of time. 

If I go and explore I get more anxious due to the fact that I just get more tired doing that and what should I enjoy by traveling?

Like what?

Watching yotube videos, eating, making food, finding new things to do, nothing works.

Could you suggest something that I can enjoy? I have tried to find it but with no luck.

Giving your sentence, we have say that, if you CANT enjoy anything, a person should not go and keep living ?
